_doc: Hand-entered Warlock effects (Forever). Tags: mainschool = the sources a chosen Demonic Sacrifice / Master Demonologist school buff applies to; pet = demon sources (Demonic Sacrifice disables them, Demonic Pact re-enables them); filler = the fire spec's nuke slot that Incinerate replaces; ability:Drains = Drain Life/Drain Soul.

Improved Corruption.note: -0.4s/rank Corruption cast (instant at 5/5) and +2%/rank Corruption damage: a 2s cast every 18s is ~11% of casting time, so each rank frees ~2.2% more filler casting time (Shadow Bolt / Drain Life / Incinerate); instant Corruption is also safer pulling while leveling. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 9.1% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 9.8% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (9.8%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, sb-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 3.7% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 4.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (4.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs -0.8% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). The damage is counted; drain healing is not in the survival term. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-30, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.2%). Siphon Life.note: Instant 30s drain DoT: ~1% of a raid warlock's damage at 60 (weak coefficient) but ~5% while leveling, and the healing makes drain-tanking safer and cuts Life Taps. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs -0.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Soul Siphon.note: Beta text (reworked): +4/8/12% Drain Life/Drain Soul/Wrack damage per other Affliction effect on the target, up to 3 effects (12/24/36%). A DoT build keeps ~2.5 effects up -> +10/20/30% on drains; the demo's healing penalty is gone. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs -0.1% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Wrack.note: Wrack (replaced Drain Hope in beta build 1.60.1.69893): 6s channel, 200 mana, 36 Shadow/s at 60 plus 14.3% of spell power per tick (~216 + 0.86 x SP per cast), and other Shadow DoTs deal +10% while it runs. Channelled once per DoT cycle (~every 18s) -> ~1/3 uptime on the +10%: ~+3% on Corruption/Agony/Doom/Siphon Life; its own damage per second is close to Shadow Bolt filler at raid spell power, so +1% overall for the extra DoT-scaling. Uptime and whether it is worth channelling on cooldown are open beta questions. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-30, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. Audit 2026-10-18: the affliction-leveling fit of 09-30 read 0 because the lab's Wrack dealt 0 until 10-17 (a parse break); re-seeded at the tooltip estimate (+3.5% on the other Shadow DoTs, +1% overall) for the next fit (row 45).
